geometry: Preserve the exact square canvas, flat-top hex footprint, camera, scale, deep tapered island, centered recessed front stairs, and transparent padding.
Keep one small circular standing patch in the lower third, horizontally centered immediately above the front stairs.
The standing patch is only large enough for Shellio and remains at the same anchor in every stage.
Let the shoreline develop around the patch without leaving the full center empty.
style: Premium cozy stylized 3D toy diorama matching the approved Shellio runtime tile.
Chunky rounded clay-like forms, broad soft bevels, matte simplified materials, low-frequency surfaces, bright diffuse coastal light, and clean silhouettes.
Use Shellio's clear turquoise, warm shell cream, sunwashed coral, pale sand, sea-glass teal, and pearl palette.
Every important feature must remain readable at 256 pixels.
persistentLandmarks: The small rear-center shell shade develops into the signature Pearl Tide Sanctuary without changing its anchor.

stages.name: Bare Shore
stages.narrative: Shellio has found a strip of warm sand, but the shore offers no shade, light, or place to pause yet.
stages.floor: Mostly bare smooth pale sand with two or three broad faded coral patches and no grains or ripples.
stages.landmark: One tiny weathered shell fragment beneath a simple rear-center cream arch frame.
props: one folded plain beach cloth at upper-left
one shallow empty stone basin at upper-right
stages.lighting: Soft neutral coastal daylight with no pearl glow.
stages.density: Very sparse, exposed, and visibly incomplete.

stages.name: First Tide Nook
stages.narrative: A little shade and one calm pool make the shore somewhere Shellio can begin to settle.
stages.floor: Smooth sun-warmed sand remains dominant with broad gentle shading and the lower standing patch.
stages.landmark: The same rear-center arch gains a small scalloped cream-and-turquoise canopy.
props: one folded beach umbrella and shell planter at upper-left
one shallow blue rock pool and two broad sea-grass forms at upper-right
stages.lighting: Bright coastal daylight with one restrained pearl-lantern glow.
stages.density: A modest first shoreline refuge made from a few broad shapes.

stages.name: Shell Garden
stages.narrative: Shellio establishes an unhurried shoreline home shaped by shade, sea glass, and safe moments near water.
stages.floor: One broad uninterrupted expanse of smooth sun-warmed sand fills the top face without texture clutter.
stages.landmark: The rear-center shade becomes a broad open-front shell cabana with scalloped turquoise canopy bands and one sea-glass inset.
props: one chunky driftwood-style bench with pearl cushion
the upper-left umbrella and shell planter
the upper-right rounded rock pool and broad sea-grass forms
stages.lighting: Soft bright coastal daylight with two broad pearl glows.
stages.density: Clearly established, breezy, and restful without beach clutter.

stages.name: Sunlit Cove
stages.narrative: The garden opens into a generous cove for long pauses, gentle curiosity, and returning to the water safely.
stages.floor: Rich broad sand, coral, and sea-glass floor masses frame the small lower standing patch without a path or plaza.
stages.landmark: The same cabana grows into a rounded two-wing cove pavilion with layered scalloped roof and luminous sea-glass center.
props: the established upper-left shaded rest nook
a larger upper-right blue rock pool with broad sea-grass masses
stages.lighting: Golden coastal daylight with warm rim light and restrained pearl glow.
stages.density: Rich and restorative through broad shoreline silhouettes, never tiny shells.

stages.name: Pearl Tide Sanctuary
stages.narrative: Shellio's home becomes the Haven's definitive waterside landmark for calm, wonder, and salt-air restoration.
stages.floor: Polished low-detail golden sand surrounds the small lower standing patch with broad sea-glass and coral accents.
stages.landmark: The same rear-center pavilion culminates in a signature grand scallop sanctuary with layered turquoise-and-cream shell roof, luminous pearl centerpiece, and broad sea-glass blue inset.
props: a resolved upper-left shaded beach lounge
a resolved upper-right tide pool garden
four oversized shell and sea-grass masses
stages.lighting: Radiant golden coastal daylight with a magical but restrained pearl landmark glow.
stages.density: Definitive signature waterside destination with a strong scalloped skyline and no micro-detail.
